summary: Bitcoin is consolidating in a tight range between 18K-24K with 20K acting as critical resistance after making a lower monthly close. Cred notes that while 20K is a good entry price for long-term investors, traders need to see a weekly close back above 20K to signal trend reversal. Ethereum is similarly range-bound between 1200-1400, with the previous cycle's all-time high at 1400 acting as resistance. Crypto markets are showing relative strength compared to equities which have broken key support levels, but overall market structure remains bearish until resistance levels are reclaimed.
